record.body:
## Rationale

The verification-direction brief's differentiator is separation (oracle author ≠ executor), information (author sees spec only), and freeze (hashes block silent edits). Shipping that full loop in this phase — plan-phase oracle author, assertion-level red via `aff check`, freeze ids/hashes on acceptances, close refuse without amendment — matches the stack decision after claim-witnesses and atomic-claims. Soft or freeze-only variants leave the product claim unenforced.

## Counter-argument

Freeze-gate-only (hashes + amendments without a separate oracle author) would ship faster and still catch silent edits. It leaves the executor writing the witness, which is the failure mode the brief targets and the reason this phase exists as its own slice.

payload.alternatives: freeze-gate only without separate author; skills-advisory freeze
payload.choice: full oracle loop: plan-phase author, freeze ids/hashes, close refuse, mechanical verify
